ios.desc:
Amiko – Where Emotional Connection Meets Real Language Learning

10 supported languages for Learning or Practice — Japanese, Spanish, English, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Korean, Esperanto

Amiko isn't a traditional language learning app, it brings learning back to life — through authentic conversations that make language a living, emotional experience.
Forget Duolingo-style lessons that feel like homework and not useful in real life. 
Your Anime-like AI partner remembers your conversations, reacts with empathy, and builds a space where mistakes are safe, laughter is natural, and learning feels like connection.
Unlike repetitive flashcards or cold grammar apps, Amiko helps you feel the language.
Every chat is natural, engaging, and emotionally rewarding — because connection is the best teacher.

8 Real-Life Practice Scenarios

Café — Share a latte and meet new friends
Restaurant — Order like a local
School — Breeze through your first day abroad
Workplace — Handle meetings and small talk naturally
Travel — Ask for directions and explore the world
Bar — Meet new people over a drink
Home — Late-night cozy chats
Beach — Relax to the sound of waves and easy conversation

16 Unique AI Characters

Each character has a distinct voice, personality, and emotional depth.
From shy book lovers to confident travelers, every encounter brings new chemistry and discovery.

Advanced AI Technology

・Emotionally expressive real-time voice interaction
・Tap any word for instant translation and example sentences
・Voice recording and pronunciation feedback
・Adaptive difficulty that grows with your level
・Smart reply suggestions for smoother chats
・Save and review learned vocabulary anytime
・Five-stage learning progress system
・Learn natural expressions through culture and context
・Immersive experience focused on emotional connection

Beautiful Design

・Anime-inspired characters
・Full-screen immersive environments
・Smooth animations and intuitive controls

Perfect For

・Learners who want real conversational practice
・Those tired of dull textbook lessons
・People preparing for travel, socializing, or work
・Anyone who wants language learning to feel human, warm, and alive

Rediscover the joy of language learning.
Download Amiko today — and make every conversation a heartfelt connection.

Supports 11 languages · No ads · Privacy-focused · Offline chat history available
